speak.title: Role-play: should I trust this expert?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: You watched a video by a very confident online coach. He explained how to make money in one clear minute. You want to pay for his course. Tell your friend why you trust him.

b.text: You think the coach sounds too sure. Ask about his experience, what he gains if people agree, and whether there is another side. Do not call your friend silly.

phrases: He sounds very sure, but what's his experience?
What does he gain if I agree?
I'm not saying he's lying, but I'd check first.
Is there another side to this?
That's a fair point, I hadn't thought of that.
Let's look for some evidence before we pay.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did the friend decide to pay, and what changed their mind?
